import subprocess,base64,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd();w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'render-transport-failure.json'],input=json.dumps({'attempt':'render-source-equations','failure':'functions JSON.parse SyntaxError Unterminated string position524288; returned image serialization truncated by tool output. Saved four PNGs and successful local receipt preserved.','repair':'Display smaller source page renders, two at a time; no network retry.'}),text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0

for page in [13,14]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-singlefile','-scale-to','900','-png','inputs/lr.pdf'],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0;arr.append(base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode())
